summary.name: Qwen3Guard
summary.one_liner: Qwen3Guard is a safety guardrail model from the Qwen family that classifies the safety of both prompts and AI responses, with risk levels and categories.
use_cases: moderating prompts sent to an LLM
filtering model responses for unsafe content
classifying risk levels of AI interactions
summary.what_it_does: The page introduces Qwen3Guard as the first safety guardrail model in the Qwen family. It is built on Qwen3 foundation models and fine-tuned for safety classification. It detects safety issues in both prompts and responses, and outputs risk levels and categorized classifications. The page claims state-of-the-art results on major safety benchmarks across English, Chinese, and multilingual inputs. Links to a tech report, GitHub, Hugging Face, ModelScope, and Discord are listed.
notable: Classifies both prompts and responses with risk levels and categories
Supports English, Chinese, and multilingual inputs
Designed for real-time safety checks on token streams
caveats: Page makes benchmark performance claims without giving figures
Pricing and license terms are not stated on the page
